catholic-encyclopedia-1913-le-puy: This 1913 reference piece on Le Puy — the Marian diocese. Georges Goyau gives its ancient story. Its bishops guard the Velay flock. The entry keeps its modest record. A see of the Gallic south. Its 3rd-century see is famed. Its Black Virgin is famed.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-rene-just-hau: René-Just Haüy was the founder of crystallography. This entry notes his discoveries, his priesthood, and his life. The father of the crystal's laws: his keen eye read the stones' geometry in crystals and gems and ores and salts and spars.
